description: Edit an existing image using AI. Currently only OpenAI (DALL-E 2) supports native image editing. For Flux/Gemini, use image_generate with a detailed prompt describing the desired output.

imageUrl.description: URL of the source image to edit (must be accessible via HTTPS)

prompt.description: Description of the edit to make

provider.description: Provider to use. Currently only "openai" supports native editing.

name: image_edit
